desc:
The golf course is covered in thousands of golf balls, and you’ve got one job: clean up every last one before time runs out! Sounds easy… until you see how much is waiting in the next yard.

Team up with your friends, upgrade your tools, and clear all 6 yards to unlock the exit!
How to play:

⛳ Collect golf balls before time runs out
💰 Sell them at baskets to earn cash
🧹 Buy and upgrade tools to clean faster
🚪 Clear each yard to unlock the next area
🤝 Work together with friends to finish the job
🏆 Reach 100% and make your escape!
